chapter: Carnegie Hall, nicknames and later career
title: The supposed feud with Duke Ellington
summary: Basie brushes off a question about a battle with Duke in Kansas City, comparing it to stepping into the ring with Joe Louis or Ali.

story.theme_name: Duke Ellington and his orchestra, as others knew them
story.community_name: Duke Ellington: the band, the man, his men

blocks.x: In Kansas City, you had a feud with Duke, didn't you? A battle with Duke?
Yeah, was there a feud? battle with Duke? Of course not. A battle with Duke?
A feud? Wait a minute. Wait what? That's the same as getting in the ring with Louis.
You mean, Joe Lewis, Mohammed Ali ... True
One champion? There's another one coming up, right?
That was he. That would have been he.
Which one was Duke? Ali or Joe Lewis?
It's the one with Ali -- that's the same as getting living in the ring with either one of them.
Well, I saw them both in there ... like Satch and Josh.
